shortDescription: Module to manage Virtual Machine Snapshots in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: disk_id
options.description: Disk id which you want to upload or download To get disk, you need to define disk_id or disk_name

options.name: disk_name
options.description: Disk name which you want to upload or download

options.name: disks
options.description: List of disks which should be created with snapshot.

options.name: download_image_path
options.description: Path on a file system where snapshot should be downloaded. Note that you must have an valid oVirt/RHV engine CA in your system trust store or you must provide it in C(ca_file) parameter. Note that the snapshot is not downloaded when the file already exists, but you can forcibly download the snapshot when using C(force) I (true).

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: keep_days_old
options.description: Number of days after which should snapshot be deleted. It will check all snapshots of virtual machine and delete them, if they are older.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: ID of the snapshot to manage.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the Virtual Machine snapshot be restore/present/absent.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: upload_image_path
options.description: Path to disk image, which should be uploaded.

options.name: use_memory
options.description: If I(true) and C(state) is I(present) save memory of the Virtual Machine if it's running. If I(true) and C(state) is I(restore) restore memory of the Virtual Machine. Note that Virtual Machine will be paused while saving the memory.

options.name: vm_id
options.description: ID of the Virtual Machine to manage. Required one of C(vm_name) or C(vm_id).

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the Virtual Machine to manage. Required one of C(vm_name) or C(vm_id).

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
